page.title: Devices & services
page.description: MQTT brokers and HTTP services, such as Node-RED, that this workspace's apps and workflows reach by key through named channels. Apps and workflows never see an address or a credential.
page.needScope: Setting up devices and services needs manage access to the workspace and the connection.manage scope, which administrators have.
page.secretOnce: The signing secret of {{name}}, shown only now. A Node-RED function node checks PaperGo-Signature with it.
page.deleteDescription: Apps and workflows that use its key stop reaching it. Its credentials are deleted.
page.needsTarget: It came from a package or a solution without its address and credentials: give them, then enable it.

editor.title: Edit {{name}}
editor.description: Its address and credentials are kept encrypted and shown only to those who manage the workspace's devices and services.
editor.keyHint: What apps and workflows name it by; from the name unless you choose one. It never changes.
editor.targetHintMqtt: mqtt://192.168.1.20:1883, mqtts://, ws:// or wss://. Addresses on a private network need the operator to list it in connections.networks; public ones need TLS and a trusted host.
editor.targetHintHttp: The base URL, such as http://192.168.1.20:1880/api. Private networks need the operator to list them in connections.networks; public addresses need https and a trusted host.
editor.credentialsKept: The saved credentials are kept unless you change them.
editor.caHint: PEM certificates to trust beside the system's, for a self-signed certificate on your network.
editor.headersHint: One Name: value per line; not for secrets.
editor.sign: Sign each call with the caller (PaperGo-Signature)

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Callers reach only what a channel covers. Two channels that see, or two that control, may not cover the same topic or path.
channels.keyHint: What apps name the channel by.
channels.topicsHint: A topic filter: + is one level, # the last levels, as in home/+/sensor/#.
channels.pathHint: From the base URL: * is one segment, a last ** one or more, as in /heating/**.

access.missingList: A list that no longer exists
access.owners: Workspace owners can always see and control. A workflow acts as its author.

monitor.title: Monitor {{name}}
monitor.description: What goes through the connection now. Only those who manage its devices and services see this.

ended.access: You can no longer see this channel.
ended.refused: The channel could not be watched.
